test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In university exams where the total maximum marks were 500, Mohit gets 20% more than Surendra, Surendra gets 20% more than Lalit, and Lalit gets 15% less than Darshan. If Mohit gets 366 marks, what percentage of the full marks does Darshan get? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]
solution:
**Given:**

Total maximum marks = 500

Mohit gets 20% more than Surendra.

Surendra gets 20% more than Lalit.

Lalit gets 15% less than Darshan.

Marks gets by Mohit = 366

Calculation:

Mohit = 120/100 of Surendra

Surendra = 120/100 of Lalit</p&g
